result.description: Team chat/messaging app (Slack alternative) by CAKE.com with channels, DMs, and a public API plus app SDK.
result.auth_detail: Two routes. (1) API-key addon: each user installs the API addon and generates keys, sent as an API key header. (2) Pumble Apps SDK OAuth2 auth-code flow: the app id is the clientId, and the code is exchanged at https://api-ga.pumble.com/oauth2/access for accessToken and botToken. Tokens need no refresh.
result.access_detail: Gate audit. (1) Review: no doc found requiring app review, publishing, or partner status for other workspaces to install an OAuth app. The authorize/install link works from Configure Apps or any external site. The only gate is that a workspace Owner or Admin must install apps (or approve member requests), which is a normal per-customer install, not a vendor review. The API-key route is per-user self-serve. I did not fetch the 'Publishing to CAKE.com Marketplace' page, so marketplace listing is optional and unverified. (2) Plan: the API addon is 'Available on all plans.' The Free plan allows up to 3 apps/integrations, and it is not stated whether the API addon counts toward that limit. Both routes are free to start. Residual risk: Free plan addon cap (3), and the MCP page states no plan requirement.
result.api_notes: The API-key addon exposes a REST API documented in Swagger: send messages, reactions, and more. The rate limit is 1000 requests/min per user. The Node SDK (pumble-sdk, v0.0.27, TypeScript) uses OAuth2 scopes, events, and slash commands. Breadth is reasonable for messaging but less than Slack's.

evidence.quote: The rate limit is up to 1000 requests per minute per user.
Only Owners and Admins can install apps.
Connect with up to 3 apps & integrations, in addition to free native integrations with Clockify and Plaky.
Generated access tokens do not need to be refreshed.
With the Pumble Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, you can connect third-party AI agents
